data.body: Implementation evidence: Gerrit change 2864 patchset 5 merged. RED/focused test: tests/scripts/test_reviewbot_e2e.py failed on the old script because it lacked the Verified wait/full trailer contract; current focused validation passes (`bash -n infra/gerrit/reviewbot-e2e.sh`, `pytest tests/scripts/test_reviewbot_e2e.py -q`). Full verification passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset via `make verify`. Gerrit gates passed: LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 on patchset 5; submit completed as MERGED. RCA: reviewbot-e2e exercised only LLM-Review and used a trailerless probe commit, so it could pass without proving the active Verified gate or CI ticket-trailer admission path. Fix: the live probe now uses a resolvable disposable/full ticket trailer, targets a replicated feature branch, reads current-patchset LLM/Verified votes, classifies negative gate votes as GATE-BLOCKED, asserts both submit requirements, and has behavioral parser/contract tests.
